definitions.dessert: Cake desserts: cheesecake and chocolate cake (Food-101).
definitions.kebab: Kebab in the broad sense, three variants: skewered meat pieces (shish, shashlik, tavuk şiş, chuan), minced meat on skewers (Adana, koobideh, seekh, lula) and döner/shawarma (meat from a rotisserie, on a plate or in bread/wrap).
